title: Madhya Pradesh Land Revenue Code, 1959
eligibility: Landowners, Farmers, and Property Holders in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Legal ownership rights and tenancy protection
Streamlined land mutation, partition, and land-use conversion processes
application_process: Step 1: Submit mutation/demarcation request on Revenue Case Management System (RCMS).
Step 2: Field inspection by Patwari / Revenue Inspector.
Step 3: Order issued by Tehsildar Court.
important_sections_or_clauses: Section 109: Duty to report acquisition of rights for land mutation
Section 110: Procedure for recording mutation in Khasra
Section 172: Conversion of agricultural land to non-agricultural purpose
